reason: The hypothesis directly combines the boron-doping strategy from P2/P4/P11/P17 with the specific energetic structural alloy Ti40Zr40W10Mo10 from P3/P13, but this combination is explicitly suggested as future work in P3 ('future studies should explore the effects of incorporating additional principal elements... on the energetic properties') and the mechanism is taken word-for-word from the boron papers. The proposal merely applies a known ductilizing intervention to a known energetic alloy without a new mechanistic link or resolution of a conflict.
